source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第六节

textbook_summary: Occasional conducted ventricular capture during VT, distinct from ventricular fusion.
invariants: Single conducted QRS/T replaces broad VT contour in selected slot
No event or second ejection at suppressed original deadline
Independent atrial schedule and following ectopic deadlines retained
Cycle stride and temporary mechanical suppression preserve original ordinals
Indexed time range lookup with bounded endpoint correction; no scan from epoch
Minimum330ms controls perfusion bounds, existing pressure morphology reference and cardiac artifact support
limitations: Authored event replacement, not AV conduction, refractory or focus-reset mechanism
Per-beat filling uses actual330/420ms capture intervals and atrial phase; no calibrated capture contractility or VT pressure
Pressure morphology follows existing minimum-RR normalization, not a clinical hemodynamic prediction
Optional fusion remains a separate slot; no polymorphic VT/TdP or onset/termination
